searchText: I thought the same but then I realized that the difficulty adjustment algorithm is flawed as it turns out that the current block is able to influence its difficulty. You don’t need to mine the parent Did I say we need to change PoW algorithm? Is this a huge problem to add one line of code to mitigate this issue? I can make a PR myself if you don’t want to deal with this. Just tell me that it won’t get ghosted as PRs from external contributors usually do. Made the PR - https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/25493 Geth team, please review this seems like a simple and efficient fix for a very real problem Aaannd rejected. After this, don’t quote it as “a major flaw” citing that we need to “merge asap ignoring all problems” Correct me if im wrong, but does this not incentivize other major pools to do the same thing? <@97774605351010304> ? Top 6 pools are roughly 80% of network hashrate, and the one in position 2 is already doing it No Unfortunately what I heard today leaves us with a need to incorporate the same strategies into our pool. Honestly very disappointed by this. Although in polite form, didn't expect to be told "\*\*\*\* off we are not doing \*\*\*\* about it" from people that maintain a platform with trillion dollars in user funds. Did you not see that the authors of the paper already disclosed it to EF months ago? wait so they replied politely but you still inserted expletives into your summary lol That's what I felt... "just because you think that PoS will moon your tiny investment" https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/692062809701482577/998496826263097414 "r/ethereum is full with Merge shills who don't understand anything technical" https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595721451651465227/986689793536708629 "all's your goal here is to shill PoS, not come with an actual consensus" https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595721451651465227/988745410904457216 "if upgrade fails, do note that hard fork coordinators [...] will be legally responsible for all losses." https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/986589483967324191 But when our community poltiely declines your request, you're suddenly outraged? People treat you better here than you treat them. You didn't care about developer's feelings when you accused them of being reckless and YOLO'ing in user funds. You are right, I did say bad words here before. I apologized via DM later It was like that up until July. But what I said above is 100% valid. To me it’s outrageous that no one even wants to accept an obvious solution to an obvious problem that is going to make people hate miners even more. But you are the one who kept saying how everything must be perfectly tested before the Merge happens. You don't know whether this "obvious" change would introduce any "not-obvious" bugs. Merge is just 2 months away; there is no point in introducing a change now, that is going to be irrelevant in 2 months. I asked and Micah replied that it would not introduce any non-obvious bugs, only cause all one-block-deep reorgs to become one-block-deep. He didn't say it wouldn't introduce any non-obvious bugs. I politely asked in this channel that is relevant to Geth development, if fixing this flaw this way would introduce any issues. Originally, I asked the Geth team but I received no response, but I received response from Micah (thanks!) saying that it would not cause any obvious problems. After some time, I figured that it’s either no one from Geth team monitors this channel either I’m ghosted or all of them blocked me for my previous arguments in this server. I decided to not wait for infinity amount of time and create the PR myself. It got closed an hour after. Then I said OK, I have another idea how to implement it that 100% doesn’t introduce any known and unknown bugs. I left a comment on my PR stating that, and asking for them to approve or reject my idea before actually implementing it, and thus wasting time. A full day since I asked without the response, I left the “I’m disappointed” message. Don’t forget that “be nice to other people if you want them to be nice to you” rule applies not just for me but to everyone, including Geth developers who are being extremely rude by ignoring me this way. For all further discussions on this topic, please DM me or make a thread if you want it to be public. No need to clutter this channel with off-topic messages. <@456226577798135808> Please.
